Fixture Coastal Ecology Program

A six-week summer field research program in coastal ecology for high school students, based at a San Diego marine field station.

Eligibility

Open to current 9th-12th grade students. No prior experience required.

Program Dates

The 2027 program runs June 14 through July 23, 2027.

Cost

Free to accepted students; a limited number of travel stipends are available.

How to Apply

Applications open December 15, 2026 and are due by March 1, 2027.
